crossRefs.note: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah deceive you; for he will not be able to deliver you out of his hand.
When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.”
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.
For Yahweh says: “We have heard a voice of trembling; a voice of fear, and not of peace.

while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”
For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

translations.web: They said to him, “Hezekiah says, ‘Today is a day of trouble, of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children have come to the point of birth, and there is no strength to deliver them.
translations.bsb: to tell him, “This is what Hezekiah says: Today is a day of distress, rebuke, and disgrace; for children have come to the point of birth, but there is no strength to deliver them.
translations.kjv: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
translations.asv: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of contumely; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
